scan_limitations: Only named high-confidence byte patterns are scanned; absence is not a proof that arbitrary secrets are absent.
No nested archive is executed or recursively unpacked; nested archives receive a byte hash and outer byte scan.
Final-release source qualification is established separately by its source-bound CI and local reports; this audit preserves their included bytes when supplied as extra frozen manifests.
This is a final package integrity audit, not a new execution or performance measurement.
